cause: heater wires from the cartridge to the board damaged; replacing them fixed it
opener: The hotend heater randomly cuts out during prints and Klipper stops with 'heater extruder not heating at expected rate'.

cause: broken thermistor wire; replaced the thermistor
opener: Klipper shuts down with 'ADC out of range'. I changed the heater cartridge but nothing changed.

evidence: medium (poster found a bad connection made during a board swap)

opener: Since I replaced the mainboard I get 'heater_bed not heating at expected rate' and the bed stays cold.

evidence: medium (adjusting the gear mesh mostly fixed it)
opener: My new build under-extrudes; walls are thin and have gaps even after calibrating.

cause: TMC drivers set to interpolate=true (motors buzz, frame resonance); belts also not tensioned correctly

evidence: medium (binding found when the joint screws were tight; fixed by de-racking)
